steps.content: In the boundless darkness, two small figures walk hand in hand, one leading the way while the other follows.
Guided by the flames, fear no longer troubles them despite the darkness.
The little torch gives you a poke.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You're the scared one. See how cold your hand is. There, hold on tight, my hand is warm.
Holding hands, the two of you tread in the darkness with the dim flames, but you're no longer afraid.
